blocks.prompt: 11 An RC circuit has an emf of 12 volts, resistance \(R = 6\,\Omega\) and capacitance \(C = 3\) farad. Initially, the capacitor is uncharged. Find the current \(I(t)\) at any time \(t\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh RC circuit (resistor aur capacitor) ka sawal hai. Dhyan dein: current poochha gaya hai, charge nahi.
Model charge \(q\) ke liye hai: \(RC\frac{dq}{dt} = CV_S - q\) (Section 4.1.1, Example 4 (i)).
Diya kya hai? \(V_S = 12\), \(R = 6\), \(C = 3\), aur shuru mein capacitor khaali: \(q(0) = 0\).
Plan: pehle \(q(t)\) nikalein, phir current \(I = \frac{dq}{dt}\) se.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(V_S = 12\) V, \(R = 6\ \Omega\), \(C = 3\) F, \(q(0) = 0\) (uncharged).
Maloom karna: \(I(t)\).
Tareeqa: \(q\) ke liye RC model (separable) hal karenge, phir derivative lenge: \(I = \frac{dq}{dt}\).

Differential equation likhein
\[RC = 6 \times 3 = 18\]
\[CV_S = 3 \times 12 = 36\]
\[18\dfrac{dq}{dt} = 36 - q\]
Kyun: RC model mein values rakhin. 36 woh poora charge hai jo capacitor aakhir kaar le lega.

Variables alag karein aur integrate karein
\[\int\dfrac{dq}{36 - q} = \int\dfrac{dt}{18}\]
\[-\ln|36 - q| = \dfrac{t}{18} + C_1\]
Kyun: \(36 - q\) ka derivative \(-1\) hai, is liye integral ke aage minus aata hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(C\) capacitance ke liye istemal ho chuka hai, is liye constant ko \(C_1\) likha.

\(q(0) = 0\) lagayein
\[-\ln 36 = C_1\]
\[\ln\left|\dfrac{36 - q}{36}\right| = -\dfrac{t}{18}\]
\[q(t) = 36\left(1 - e^{-t/18}\right)\]
Kyun: \(C_1\) wapas rakha, logarithms ko jora (\(\ln a - \ln b = \ln\frac{a}{b}\)), aur \(e\) liya. \(t = 0\) par \(36 - q = 36\) positive hai, is liye \(+\) sign liya.

Current nikalein
\[I = \dfrac{dq}{dt} = 36 \cdot \dfrac{1}{18}e^{-t/18}\]
\[I(t) = 2e^{-t/18}\]
Kyun: current charge ke behne ki raftar hai. \(\frac{d}{dt}e^{-t/18} = -\frac{1}{18}e^{-t/18}\), aur aage wala minus is ke saath mil kar plus ban gaya.

Tasdeeq
\(I(0) = 2 = \frac{12}{6} = \frac{V_S}{R}\): shuru mein khaali capacitor par koi voltage nahi, saara voltage resistor par \(\checkmark\).
\[RI + \dfrac{q}{C} = 12e^{-t/18} + 12 - 12e^{-t/18} = 12 \;\checkmark\]
Current waqt ke saath zero ki taraf jata hai jab capacitor bhar jata hai; RL circuit mein ulta hota hai.
